audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple content fields described 'The Weirding's banish' — The Weirding (E) is a damaging slow blast with a backward hop; nothing in Riot's text banishes. The setup ability is Between Worlds (R): leap, shockwave, slow zone with side-to-side teleport. Two fields also credited 'Golden Eclipse reflect' — the reflect is W Rebuttal. Missing interaction: Rebuttal's terrain/immunity answers her W/R engage — hold it for the engage, not the poke.
